Package trxsh.ontop.theUltimateSMPLib.item.lore

Class LoreBuilder

java.lang.Object
trxsh.ontop.theUltimateSMPLib.item.lore.LoreBuilder
public class LoreBuilder extends Object
Simple lore builder for custom items. The methods are recursive, allowing single line lore building See: CustomItemStack.java
